description: This file defines the class TappedAndroidUserDictionary, which extends AndroidUserDictionary and overrides the createWordReadListener method to return a custom WordReadListener, used for handling word tap events in the user dictionary.

classes.name: TappedAndroidUserDictionary
classes.description: A subclass of AndroidUserDictionary that provides a custom WordReadListener for tap events.

methods.name: TappedAndroidUserDictionary
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the dictionary with context, locale, and a WordReadListener for tap events.

methods.name: createWordReadListener
methods.description: Overrides the method to return the custom WordReadListener assigned during construction.
